name: Semitronix Corporation
summary: Semitronix Corporation provides characterization and yield improvement solutions for the semiconductor industry in China and internationally. It offers SmtCell, a parameterized cell (PCell) layout design platform that creates various PCells and layouts; TCMagic, a test chip layout automation design platform, which provides automatic layout creation, placing and routing, design documentation, and testing program generation; and ATCompiler, an addressable test layout automation chip design platform, which include process development and yield improvement solutions.
